tasks.short: Select finishing ingredients for the actual furniture surface

steps.what: Inspect the actual furniture, identify wood hardness and surface type and assess the existing coating and required finish
inputs: Actual furniture and customer finish requirements

steps.what: Find and check the actual supplier technical and compatibility sheets for candidate paint, stain, lacquer, shellac or varnish
inputs: Existing supplier technical sheets indexed by product
outputs: Applicable product information and unresolved compatibility questions

steps.what: Select appropriate finishing ingredients using the actual substrate, supplier instructions and any required test patch
outputs: Selected finishing ingredients or unresolved compatibility issue

tasks.design: Configure a product-indexed supplier-sheet library in {DOCS}. The finisher checks the actual technical sheets and selects ingredients from physical inspection and compatibility testing; the index does not prescribe a finish.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current technical sheet can require repeated product searches.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document indexes can link exact product identifiers to their supplier sheets.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying old coatings, variable wood surfaces and compatibility on the actual piece.
tasks.human_edge: The finisher examines and tests the furniture rather than trusting a textual description alone.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document libraries can index supplier technical sheets by product identifier.

assumptions: The finisher supplies actual substrate observations in s1; suppliers supply existing technical sheets and s2 checks exact product and version. Missing compatibility information stops selection pending actual testing or clarification.
No new sensor feed, automatic chemical decision, material order or application is proposed.
No required selection record is established by the statement; actual workshop recording, if required, must be added and measured rather than assumed free.
Illustrative gross saving 6 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1, net 5. Existing one-click technical links earn no additional saving.
unknowns: Actual technical-sheet search effort and current product indexing
research_questions: Which products lack an exact, current technical-sheet link in the workshop library?

already_counted.description: Check the actual supplier sheets and compatibility information

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured reference-retrieval scenario; physical inspection and selection retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Agree furniture colors and finishes with customers

steps.what: Retrieve and check the existing customer job brief and recorded furniture requirements
Confer with the customer using actual furniture and finish samples to determine preferred colors and finishes and clarify limitations
outputs: Actual agreed color and finish choice or unresolved preference

steps.what: Enter and check the actual agreed finish and sample identifier in the existing job work order
Save the final checked finish specification in the same work-order system

tasks.design: Use the job-linked brief and finish-selection fields in the existing workshop {OPS_SYSTEM}. The customer discussion remains human, and the finisher records and checks the actual chosen finish before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated job lookup and re-entering finish catalogue details can add recording effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing work-order forms can reuse job identity and selected sample metadata.
tasks.still_hard: Subjective color preferences and differences between samples and the actual furniture.
tasks.human_edge: The finisher clarifies what the customer means and explains physical limitations.

ambition.what: Reduce preparation and existing work-order recording effort.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: work-order forms can reuse job and finish-sample identifiers while a person enters the actual customer choice.

assumptions: The workshop already requires a chosen-finish specification in its work order; no extra meeting report is added.
Existing job staff supply the brief and finish catalogue; the finisher captures actual customer choices in s3. Missing sample identifiers require manual clarification.
No customer confirmation message or production release is silently sent. Any actual separate send needs its own final-version check and send step.
Illustrative gross saving 6.8 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1.5, net 5.3. Same-system save earns no saving.
unknowns: Current work-order fields and actual repeated finish-data entry
research_questions: Can the chosen sample populate its exact identifier and description in the current work order?

already_counted.description: Check the brief and enter and check actual customer choices

incremental.description: Maintain finish-sample fields and job links

approvals.approved_version: Final finish specification checked in s3; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured existing-work-order scenario; lookup and repeated catalogue fields reduced after upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend woods, colors, finishes and furniture styles

steps.what: Clarify the customer's actual use, taste, budget and furniture constraints
inputs: Actual customer requirements and furniture context

steps.what: Retrieve and check current wood, color, finish and style references and available sample details
inputs: Existing product and style references and sample catalogue

steps.what: Choose and check suitable recommendations against the actual furniture, customer needs and product limitations
outputs: Final checked recommendation and its limitations

steps.what: Communicate the checked recommendations and limitations to the customer using the actual samples
inputs: Final checked recommendation and actual samples

tasks.design: Configure reference retrieval in {DOCS} using the workshop's actual sample catalogue and product information. The finisher judges suitability and checks the recommendation before personally explaining it to the customer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant product and style references can be scattered across catalogues.
tasks.enabler_now: An existing indexed document view can narrow retrieval by the customer's actual constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Taste, visual judgment and predicting how a finish will look on a particular piece.
tasks.human_edge: The finisher combines material knowledge with the customer's preferences.

ambition.what: Reduce reference-search effort within personal advice.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed product and sample catalogues can reduce reference retrieval while leaving aesthetic and material choices with the finisher.

assumptions: The workshop and suppliers supply existing references; the finisher captures customer needs in s1 and checks current product details in s2.
No model trend claim, invented product or automatic recommendation is proposed. No written recommendation report is established for this verbal-advice episode.
The final recommendation is selected and checked in s3 before communication; a substantive change requires checking again.
Illustrative gross saving 7.5 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1.5, net 6. Count any shared catalogue lookup with task 14265 once.
unknowns: Actual catalogue-search effort and whether references are already indexed
research_questions: Can current sample and product references be filtered by material and intended use?

already_counted.description: Check product sources and judge and check the final recommendation

incremental.description: Maintain sample and product reference index

approvals.approved_version: Final recommendation checked in s3; changed advice requires rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured verbal-advice scenario; reference retrieval reduced, with actual judgment and customer explanation retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Follow blueprints to produce furniture designs

steps.what: Retrieve and check the current blueprint revision for the furniture job
inputs: Existing approved job blueprint and revision record

steps.what: Interpret the blueprint's dimensions, surface details and design requirements against the actual furniture
Follow the blueprint to produce and check the specific design on the actual furniture
outputs: Physical furniture design checked against blueprint

tasks.design: Use the current-job blueprint link in {DOCS} to reduce revision searches. The finisher still interprets and physically produces the design and checks it against the actual blueprint.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating the right blueprint revision can require repeated searching.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document version controls and job links can point to the current blueprint.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting details and reproducing them on a real surface.
tasks.human_edge: The finisher adapts skilled handwork to the actual piece while meeting the design.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document version controls can link a job to its current approved blueprint.

assumptions: A drawing owner already supplies the actual blueprint; s1 checks identity and revision. Missing dimensions or conflicts return to that owner.
No free CAD model, machine program, written completion report or production send is assumed by this physical blueprint-following task.
Illustrative gross saving 3 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1, net 2; existing one-click drawing retrieval earns no additional saving.
unknowns: Actual revision-search effort and any workshop-required completion record
research_questions: Does the existing job already link directly to the current approved drawing?

already_counted.description: Check the blueprint identity and revision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured existing-blueprint scenario; physical design production remains fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Use existing workshop work-order and document functions with actual product and sample identifiers.
skills_to_grow: Check product compatibility on actual surfaces
role.ambitious_version: A furniture finisher who finds reliable references and records agreed finishes with less repeated entry while retaining material judgment, customer advice and physical craft.
